fusions.name: Anchor Drop
fusions.desc: Drops a cold iron anchor around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Grapnel Bite
fusions.desc: A strike that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Moored Fast
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending Shank
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10% at all times.
